title: Phase 2 - Request for disconnection of the power supply - Edit (2)

User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to update Request for disconnection of the power supply's data

So that I will have possibility to correct my mistake

 

Design: Request for disconnection of the power supply (adobe.com)

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Check system user permissions to see edit icon on Request for disconnection of the power supply's listing/detail page. If no such permission, edit icon will be disabled

    1. Edit Draft Request for disconnection of the power supply

      1. Allows to edit all Request for disconnection of the power supplies' objects with status Draft

  2. It is possible to edit only Draft object and Executed. objects with the status Fee charged should be locked and it is not possible to edit

  3. Clicking on an edit icon on listing/detail page will allow edit mode

  4. All fields are editable with the regular flow for Draft object

    1. List of PODs should be updated when object is with status Draft and is opened in Edit mode. If for POD all overdue liabilities are payed the POD should be removed from the list.

    2. PODs listed on the second tab (POD tab) are filtered according to the Supplier type selected on the request header and the customer from the linked Reminder for disconnection:

      1. If Supplier type is Current, only PODs that are active on the current date in the contract of the customer (customer ID) included in the reminder are listed.

      2. If Supplier type is Previous, only PODs that are not active on the current date in the contract of that customer (from the reminder) are listed.

    3. This filter applies when the POD tab is loaded or refreshed (including after changing Supplier type, Grid operator, or Reminder for disconnection on tab 1).

  5. For Executed objects it is possible to edit only:

    1. Files – to be able to upload new files or to delete manually uploaded files

    2. Button Charge fee is accessible for Executed object

    3. Charge fee button process -https://app.diagrams.net/?splash=0#G1Lnk3MdD3DByEpPN8s1-BCLJC3H4yxrr2#{"pageId"%3A"JsA6_ep1HPjiPbuoDtFs"}

  6. When object is saved as a Draft and user opens it (preview/edit modes), system should check if the Overdue liabilities are paid or not.

    1. If paid, such respective rows from the listing should be removed

  7. When object is saved as a Draft and user opens it (preview/edit modes), system should check if there are another Overdue liabilities found in the system according to the conditions and should display additional rows in the listing

  8. When object is saved and Executed and user opens it on edit/preview modes, only the already executed data should be displayed in the listing and system shouldn't check anything

  9. Task's sub-object should be enable and optional in all flows - when object is Draft, Executed or Fee Charged

    1. Clicking on Plus button will open Task' creation page where Request for disconnection of the power supply object should be already set as a sub-object

    2. Separate editing

    3. After creating a Task and clicking on Refresh button, newly created task should be set with the following logic:

      1. Task number-Creation date-Task type

    4. In the task sub-object, a maximum of 10 tasks should be displayed on one pagination page.

    5. Task list logic:

      1. The tasks ordering should be descending by time creation

      2. Also the task format should be changed, we need to have the next format:

        1. Id

          1. Take from task number field - This logic is already added

        2. Display task status

          1. Task status should be taken from task object

          2. In the system we have the next task statuses:

            1. Open

            2. In Progress

            3. Terminated

            4. Overdue

            5. Completed

        3. Date in format DD.MM.YYYY

          1. This logic is already added.

        4. Task type

          1. Task type should be taken from task type dropdown - this logic is already added

        5. Example:

          1. 841 - in progress – 26.02.2025 - YOLS-TEST

    6. It is possible to click already added record or an arrow and system should open task's page in new browser window

    7. It is possible to remove already added task from the Request for disconnection of the power supply object

  10. Clicking on 'Save as a draft' button will update Request for disconnection of the power supply object

    1. System will check all validations and if successful will save changes, else error

  11. Clicking on 'Save and execute' button will update Request for disconnection of the power supply object and will start process of generating documents for Grid operator, and will change status to Executed

    1. System will check all validations and if successful will save changes, else error

  12. When Executed object is opened for editing Save, Cancel and Charge fee buttons should be visible

    1. Clicking on 'Charge fee' button will start process of generating taxes for each of the selected PODs for which executed Cancelation of the request does not exist, and will change status to Fee charged

  13. When Fee Charged object is opened for editing Cancel button should be visible

  14. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button should check changes and if there are changes made then warning pop-up message comes out with buttons: 'Your changes are not saved, are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close request for disconnection of the power supply's editing page and return to listing page

    2. No - will close warning pop-up and stay on request for disconnection of the power supply's editing page

    3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings

  15. Audit Log record should be created

In sub-object Tasks in every object (customer, invoice, etc.): - the order should be descending by time creation

  1. Customer

  2. Contract/Order

  3. Billing run

  4. Communication - Email/SMS

  5. Receivable

    1. Mass operation for blocking

    2. Late payment fine

    3. Objection to a change of a balancing group coordinator

    4. Objection withdrawal to a change of a balancing group coordinator

    5. Reminder for disconnection of power supply

    6. Request for disconnection of the power supply

    7. Cancellation of disconnection of the power supply

    8. Disconnection of power supply

    9. Reconnection of the power supply

    10. Rescheduling

In sub-object Tasks in every object (customer, invoice, etc.): - the order should be descending by time creation;
